-  Mise-en-place preparation and freshness.

-  Cooking and service of food according to the restaurant’s quality and service standards.
-  Training of kitchen staff as directed by Chef-in-charge.
-  Safety and cleanliness of all kitchen and food storage areas.
-  Ensuring high levels of kitchen team performance.
-  Contributing to creating a harmonious environment amongst all staff within the restaurant

-  Prepare and cook high quality food according to menu guidelines and recipes.
-  Ensuring that all dishes reach the hot plate or passe correctly garnished, the correct portion and size, presented on the correct serving dish in the prescribed manner.

-  Supervising members of the kitchen team who are responsible to you.
-  Ensuring that junior chefs and trainees receive the right training and optimum guidance.
-  Helping to create good communication between floor and kitchen staff and within the kitchen.
-  Receiving and safe storage of food.
-  Assisting with regular stock takes.
-  Receiving, recording and accounting for supplies and deliveries.
-  Maintaining restaurant cost control systems as they affect your area of responsibilities.
-  Following correct hygienic food handling practices. 
-  Following the restaurant’s regular cleaning and waste disposal practices.
-  Optimising the use of restaurant resources: food, energy, labour, water.
-  Using safe work practices and supporting others to use them.
-  Being fully aware of the venue’s Fire Safety Procedures and Health & Safety regulations. Maintain kitchen equipment and plant in good condition. 
-  Participating in team meetings.
-  Attending training courses and seminars as and when required.
-  Carrying out other duties typically expected of the position as required from time to time.

Skills & Attributes:  

- Must have 3 years’ experience as a Chef 
- Diploma in Commercial Cookery or related Qualification 
- OH&S awareness 
- Food Handling and RSA certificates required

result.description:
Position: Community Worker
Type: Full-time
Employer: Victorian Home and Community Care Pty Ltd
Location: Narromine NSW 2821
Salary: $85,000 – $100,000 p/a
About the Business:
Victorian Home and Community Care Pty Ltd (VHCC) is a registered NDIS provider delivering person-centred disability support services across NSW and Victoria. We specialise in community participation, assistance with daily living, personal care (including high-intensity supports), supported independent living, community nursing, psychosocial recovery coaching, support coordination and allied health services. With a team of over 300 multicultural and bilingual care workers, we focus on building independence, dignity and community connection for participants. Our culture values compassion, cultural responsiveness, trauma-informed practice and genuine partnership with participants and families to help them achieve their goals.
About the Position:
The Community Worker role is central to VHCC’s mission of supporting vulnerable people in the Narromine region and surrounds. You will assess community needs, deliver informal counselling and life-skills education, and actively connect participants to essential services so they can live more independently and participate fully in community life. This position plays a key part in translating NDIS plans into practical, meaningful outcomes on the ground.
Key Responsibilities:
Assess individual and community needs to identify barriers and opportunities for greater independence and participation
Provide informal counselling and emotional support to participants and their families
Deliver life-skills education and capacity-building activities tailored to individual goals
Connect participants with essential support services, mainstream community resources and specialist providers
Facilitate community participation and social inclusion activities
Maintain accurate records and contribute to support planning and review processes
Work collaboratively with support coordinators, allied health professionals and other team members
Uphold NDIS quality and safeguarding standards, privacy and participant dignity at all times
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply
Bachelor Degree in the field
Minimum 1 year relevant experience
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with people from diverse backgrounds
Sound assessment, problem-solving and organisational skills
Ability to work independently in a community-based setting while following organisational policies and NDIS requirements
Empathy, cultural sensitivity and a genuine commitment to person-centred practice
Current drivers licence and willingness to travel within the local area as required
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Eilbeck Cranes is an 100% Australian owned company operating in Australia for 118 years specialising in the design, manufacture and installation of all types of overhead cranes, hoists and winches.

We are currently seeking a Mechanical Engineering Technician – Crane Systems Support to join our team in our Perth, Western Australia Office.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

1.	1.	Review mechanical drawings and engineering specifications of crane and winch components to identify appropriate replacement parts.
2.	Analyse RFQ requests and preparing technical quotations for engineered crane components.
3.	Assess mechanical tolerances, materials and compatibility of fabricated parts.
4.	Coordinate fabrication or machining of crane components with manufacturing teams.
5.	Maintain engineering documentation and spare parts technical databases for crane systems.
6.	Support engineering and production teams to ensure components meet design specifications and safety requirements.
7.	Develop spare parts data base for Eilbeck Winches
8.	Respond to requests for quotation (RFQ) for Eilbeck Winch spare parts and other parts from time to time
9.	Research in archived jobs to determine parts required for the RFQ
10.	Assist in the Spare Parts Division as requested from time to time
11.	Follow up quotation with customers
12.	Process awarded purchase orders into jobs
13.	Procurement of parts and/raw materials required for the Job. 
14.	Project manage the production of required parts along with other Eilbeck Division leads.  
15.	Ensure that work be performed, within agreed times and to an acceptable standard ensuring all work completed.
16.	Updating computer inventory
17.	Ensure parts invoicing is completed in a timely manner.

Bachelor BSC in Mechanical Engineering
Overhead Crane experience
Excellent verbal, written communication and organisational skills

SALTER BROTHERS HOSPITALITY RETREAT COMPANY NO. 2 PTY LTD  
  

Position  : Full-Time
Location : Blue Mountains NSW 2785
Salary     : $79,423 to $130,000 a year
  

Nestled on the edge of the Greater Blue Mountains National Park and Hunter Valley Wine Country is the Salter Brothers Hospitality collection of distinctive luxury accommodations and restaurants encapsulating heritage, indulgence and character at its best.
  
The five properties are unique to the Blue Mountains and Hunter Valley regions and provide an immersive journey through Australia’s most visited tourism destinations.
  
“Echoes Boutique Hotel and Restaurant / Hydro Majestic Hotel / Lilianfels Blue Mountains Resort and Spa / Parklands Country Gardens and Lodge / The Convent Hunter Valley”
  
Salter Brothers Hospitality Group is seeking seeking Restaurant Manger / Assistant Restaruant Manager/Assistant General Manager Food and Beverage Manager to join their teams.
  
Task and Responsibilities:
Ensure restaurants, bars and event service is provided as per company Sequence of Service and RSA requirements.
Ensure outlets are always presented to an impeccable standard.
Collaborate with the Head Chef to produce an appealing and unique menu.
Coordination of bookings (including functions and events)
Ensure compliance with licensing and hygiene legislation/guidelines.
Ensure the food and beverage operational and financial objectives are met.
Resolve guest grievances tactfully and promptly.
Ensure optimum ordering of stock & ensure accurate stocktakes are conducted monthly.
Ensure the food and beverage team are aware and adheres to current budgets and targets.
Always ensure compliance with the provisions of the Workplace Health and Safety Act and Regulations.
Motivate and drive the food and beverage team through ongoing training, coaching, and mentoring.

Skills and Experience:
Relevant qualification in the hospitality industry
At least 2 years of relevant experience.
Proven management experience working in hospitality/customer service environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead a team and get results.
Exceptional organisation and problem-solving skills.
Excellent presentation and grooming standards.
Technical product knowledge in food and wine.
Understanding of budgets and forecasting.
Knowledge of POS and end-of-day reconciliation procedures
Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills


If you meet the above criteria please apply now, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

ONLY PEOPLE WHO SUPPLY A RESUME WILL BE CONSIDERED!


NFR Holdings PTY LTD is seeking for experienced Customer Experience Department Managers to join the team at McDonald's Restaurants at the locations in Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas.

Vacancy address Mackay, 4740 QLD and surrounding regional areas:

102 Shakespeare Street, East Mackay, Queensland 4740

23-39 Oak Street, Andergrove QLD 4740

Tenancy: Position is available full-time 38/h per week

Salary: $80,000



Task and Duties include (but not limited to)

·Sales and Guest count analysis weekly monthly reports analysis, summaries and sharing KPIs and tracking with the executive manager, owner.

·Hiring and training new employees to service areas of the business that best meets the sales volumes and customer demands. designing training plans and checking in on progress

·Planning, and executing crew schedules based on careful analysis of sales patterns and crew proficiencies in all areas of the business including kitchen, drive thru, cafe, front counter etc.

·Setting and monitoring sales projections taking into consideration promotions, weather, competitive activity etc and adjusting the rosters accordingly.

·Marketing /communications Promotions activating McDonalds instore promotions and local area marketing initiatives for example McHappy Day

·Identifies the varying requirements of our customers and seeks to develop innovative solutions to meet their needs.

·Ensures a customer obsessed mindset through the management team and crew through effective training, rewards and appraisals.

·Verifying food safety daily weekly monthly minimums are met to ensure our customer safety.

·Labour analysis and planning daily weekly monthly tracking of, average hourly rate, sales per crew hour etc to ensure we have the right crew for the sales patterns whilst staying in budget.

·People compliance management such as breaks and all child labour responsibilities in line with the state legislation.

·Ensuring staff all work in a safe manner and in accordance with the McDonalds policies and procedures.

·Checking and planning inventory to ensure we have the right product mix and volumes to meet the demands of our local customers.

·Reporting on inventory controls and costs.

·Maintain the facilities with a focus on customer areas to ensure the best possible customer experience.

·Quality assurance of products to maintain gold standard of food and beverage production.(involves crew training and equipment maintenance

·Customer service reviews responses reviewing the online customer service portal and responding to customers and resolving issues.

·Represent the organisation at official occasions, conventions, seminars.

·Embraces and promotes the McDonalds open-door policy.

Only fully qualified and experienced applicants will be considered.



Qualifications & Experience: AQF Diploma plus 1 year experience or 3 years of managerial experience
